firstPlayerRule: The most daring player goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: That player receives the first-player and Timeline markers and selects the first round's Timeline.
The earlier Housing and Department setup choice begins with the player to the starter's right and runs counterclockwise.
In solo play, you choose the first round's Timeline before Andrew chooses a later round's.
